correctness.rationale: The exact Fano-plane construction yields a 28-vertex, 42-edge cubic Coxeter graph. Exhaustive seven-cycle enumeration gives 24 heptagons and 108 disjoint heptagon pairs. The unordered 2-particle cubical deleted-product chain groups have ranks (378,1092,777); all boundary compositions and all 108 torus cycle identities vanish over Z. A complete F101 elimination gives rank(d2)=700, while 77 torus classes possess a coordinate minor of determinant -1, so they give a primitive integral basis of ker(d2)=H2=Z^77. All 336 automorphisms yield bridge-count orbits 84 and 24. The 84 orbit has mod-3 rank 76, and two integer maximal minors -273 and 5427 with gcd 3; these force full-rank lattice index exactly 3. Exact Smith forms cross-check (1^76,3) and the 24-orbit rank 23. Transitivity on the 24 orbit implies each class is nonzero in the quotient and hence any one completes the generating lattice. Recomputed from bundled verify.py with declared dependencies.

value.rationale: The Coxeter graph is a canonical 28-vertex symmetric cubic graph of girth seven and nonplanar genus. Its canonical shortest cycles yield a natural geometric torus system, not an arbitrary slice. The 84-element orbit has the full rational span but index-three integral obstruction; the other 24-element orbit repairs the defect one generator at a time. This is structural arithmetic information invisible to Betti numbers or rational spans, directly motivated by the known failure of planar-only torus generation principles for general nonplanar graphs. The result is an exact, reproducible finite classification rather than a routine normalization or parameter substitution.
